echo_sets.name: Eternal Radiance
echo_sets.note: The 2-pc gives 10% Spectro DMG. The 5-pc gives 20% Crit Rate when she inflicts Spectro Frazzle. It also gives a 15% Spectro DMG Bonus against enemies at 10+ Frazzle stacks. Capitaneus (3-cost main) adds Spectro and Heavy Attack DMG. Nightmare: Mourning Aix (4-cost) is the alternative main.

echo_sets.name: Celestial Light
echo_sets.note: Noticeably weaker than Eternal Radiance, but usable while you farm it. It grants Spectro DMG, which jumps higher after an Intro Skill.

echo_sets.name: Eternal Radiance + Celestial Light
echo_sets.note: A stopgap 2+2 split for Spectro DMG, while you complete a 5-pc Eternal Radiance set.

build.energy_regen_target: No fixed target from guides — ER is a low-priority substat for Zani; stack only enough for comfortable Liberation uptime.
build.fast_path: Fast path: Blazing Justice + 5-piece Eternal Radiance in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Capitaneus in the main slot. Use Crit DMG on the 4-cost, Spectro DMG Bonus on the 3-costs, and ATK% on the 1-costs. Push Crit Rate, Crit DMG, and ATK% in substats. Energy Regen is a low priority — take only enough for comfortable Liberation uptime.

ranked_weapons.name: Blazing Justice
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. It has a Crit DMG substat and an ATK boost. It gives DEF ignore on Basic Attacks. It also greatly amplifies Spectro Frazzle DMG. Best in slot by far.

ranked_weapons.name: Tragicomedy
ranked_weapons.note: Phoebe's signature gauntlets; Crit Rate substat plus a Heavy Attack DMG buff that lines up with Zani's burst window.

ranked_weapons.name: Verity's Handle
ranked_weapons.note: Attribute bonus buff and Resonance Liberation DMG; weaker uptime than Tragicomedy if Liberations are infrequent.

ranked_weapons.name: Abyss Surges
ranked_weapons.note: Solid fallback if you need more Energy Regen; otherwise outclassed by the Crit weapons above.

ranked_weapons.name: Stonard
ranked_weapons.note: The best 4-star option, from the battle pass. It gives Crit Rate plus Resonance Liberation DMG. The Liberation scaling is worth less to her than Heavy Attack DMG, though.

ranked_weapons.name: Celestial Spiral
ranked_weapons.note: ATK% stat stick with easier Liberation cycling after Resonance Skill; serviceable placeholder.

stat_priorities.note: The Eternal Radiance 5-pc already grants 20% Crit Rate on Frazzle, so Crit DMG usually wins. Use Crit Rate if your substats are short.
Spectro DMG Bonus on both 3-costs; the core of her Frazzle scaling.

profile.role_note: A burst DPS built on Spectro Frazzle. She pairs with Phoebe, who applies Spectro Frazzle for her.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: Skip pulling for her right now. She has no active banner. She also needs Phoebe (or another Frazzle applier) to reach her full strength. She is still one of the strongest Frazzle carries in the game. But newer dedicated DPS options have closed the gap. Only chase her rerun if you already run a Spectro Frazzle team, or you like her Heavy Attack burst playstyle.

members.name: Zani
members.note: The Frazzle carry; bursts through her enhanced heavy-attack window once Phoebe stacks Spectro Frazzle.

members.name: Phoebe
members.note: Applies and stacks Spectro Frazzle while dealing her own damage; Zani's enabler.

members.name: Shorekeeper
members.note: Stellarealm Crit and damage buffs plus healing to support both Frazzle teammates.

teams.name: Premium: Zani + Phoebe + Shorekeeper
teams.rotation: Phoebe opens. She applies Spectro Frazzle and builds Concerto Energy. Shorekeeper deploys Stellarealm for buffs and healing. Swap into Zani and fill her Forte gauge. Then cast her Resonance Liberation. Burn through her enhanced Heavy Attack burst window while the Frazzle stacks are high.

members.name: Zani
members.note: Still the Frazzle carry; needs a Frazzle source since Phoebe is missing.

members.name: Spectro Rover
members.note: Free-to-play Frazzle applier to feed Zani's kit.

members.name: Verina
members.note: Healing and damage amplification with minimal field time.

teams.name: Budget: Zani + Spectro Rover + Verina
teams.rotation: Spectro Rover applies Spectro Frazzle and builds Concerto. Verina refreshes buffs and healing. Then Outro into Zani for her Forte-charged Liberation burst.

tier_badge.label: Strong DPS
tier_badge.note: Sources disagree on where she stands now. One October 2026 version 3.7 list keeps Zani in S. Another October 2026 list dropped her to C (from B), citing newer competition. A v3.6 list has her at A. She stays strong in dedicated Frazzle teams. She is no longer a top pick for everyone, though.
